items.text: Sprint is now a toggleable option in the in‑game settings that persists across sessions, giving players consistent sprint behavior.
Server connection slots now scale with the configured max‑player limit, allowing larger player populations without the previous 1024‑player cap.

Scientists use a replay‑based aim system and corrected rotation, eliminating tilting and upside‑down targeting, and they now navigate doors correctly, resulting in more realistic and accurate combat behavior.
Thruster module recipe increased from 40 to 60 explosives, making it harder to craft.
Underwear now stays attached to each character slot, preventing loss when switching slots.
Body types without underwear parts no longer leave the player naked.
Fixed layer‑mask bug so trees, ore nodes and junkpiles correctly block each other, eliminating spawn overlaps.
Fishing villages now keep a safe distance from river mouths, improving settlement placement.
Cave terrain blends are prevented from overlapping monument topology and underground tunnel entrances.
Sleeping bag respawn logic adjusted to stop bags from getting stuck and removed the space‑check on manual respawn.
Bag bounds tweaked so bags can be deployed right next to each other.
Mission item dispensers now correctly track objectives and progress, including items stored in backpacks.
Item drops are no longer blocked on thin surfaces such as oil‑rig floors.
Deployables placed beside a split‑off part of a base now stay with the correct building.
Car repel force works even when the car is exactly on an animal, restoring intended vehicle‑animal interaction.
Sprinklers no longer make players wet through floors or ceilings.

2026-11-23.summary:
### Movement & Controls
- Sprint is now a toggleable option in the in‑game settings that persists across sessions, giving players consistent sprint behavior.

### Server Capacity
- Server connection slots now scale with the configured max‑player limit, allowing larger player populations without the previous 1024‑player cap.

### NPC & AI
- Scientists use a replay‑based aim system and corrected rotation, eliminating tilting and upside‑down targeting, and they now navigate doors correctly, resulting in more realistic and accurate combat behavior.

### Gameplay & Balance
- Thruster module recipe increased from 40 to 60 explosives, making it harder to craft.

### Character Creator
- Underwear now stays attached to each character slot, preventing loss when switching slots.
- Body types without underwear parts no longer leave the player naked.

### World Generation & Environment
- Fixed layer‑mask bug so trees, ore nodes and junkpiles correctly block each other, eliminating spawn overlaps.
- Fishing villages now keep a safe distance from river mouths, improving settlement placement.
- Cave terrain blends are prevented from overlapping monument topology and underground tunnel entrances.

### Sleeping Bag & Respawn
- Sleeping bag respawn logic adjusted to stop bags from getting stuck and removed the space‑check on manual respawn.
- Bag bounds tweaked so bags can be deployed right next to each other.

### Mission Items
- Mission item dispensers now correctly track objectives and progress, including items stored in backpacks.

### Item Dropping & Building
- Item drops are no longer blocked on thin surfaces such as oil‑rig floors.
- Deployables placed beside a split‑off part of a base now stay with the correct building.

### Vehicles & Interactions
- Car repel force works even when the car is exactly on an animal, restoring intended vehicle‑animal interaction.

### Sprinklers
- Sprinklers no longer make players wet through floors or ceilings.

items.text: Monuments are arranged in eccentric rings with the endgame core offset to one side; the Power Plant sits centrally, core monuments lean inward and are anchored to specific rings.
The first closing balloon is placed in the outer ring, away from hatches.
Tier‑2 monuments now host gunner drones that fire pistol rounds with recoil.

Core monuments are guarded by AI; when their guards are depleted helicopters can deliver reinforcements and a Bradley patrols the core area, and players receive warnings near monuments and before a balloon closes.
Backpack sale price is fixed at 400 after completing Missing Shipment, and loot items have fixed rarity‑based pricing that no longer varies with colour.

Item values are calculated from supply stock and a fixed shop list (bandit camp excluded); gold‑floor items, condition‑scaled sales and blueprint prices are defined without bandit influence, the safe pocket only accepts non‑weapon/armour items and values them as the shop would pay, and the shop now buys only finished goods while components are sent to a recycler for a refund.
Stash capacity increased by two rows at a time up to a maximum of 96 slots.
Low‑tier crates and barrels now contain fewer tools and weapons, and junk‑pile crates no longer include ring parts.

Extraction balloons no longer carry a secondary hot‑air balloon; escape hatches can be opened with a Cobalt bypass card; outer‑ring crates now have a rare jackpot chance; and raid duration is extended to 35 minutes.
Raid reset now removes player‑placed structures along with their contents.
Improved beach spawn locations reduce clustering and give more reliable initial placement.
Fishing vendor updates add new bait options and adjust pricing for better resource management.
Fixed overlapping train tunnel geometry, preventing players from getting stuck or falling through tunnels.

2026-11-22.summary:
### Map Layout
- Monuments are arranged in eccentric rings with the endgame core offset to one side; the Power Plant sits centrally, core monuments lean inward and are anchored to specific rings.
- The first closing balloon is placed in the outer ring, away from hatches.

### AI & Reinforcements
- Tier‑2 monuments now host gunner drones that fire pistol rounds with recoil.
- Core monuments are guarded by AI; when their guards are depleted helicopters can deliver reinforcements and a Bradley patrols the core area, and players receive warnings near monuments and before a balloon closes.

### Economy & Pricing
- Backpack sale price is fixed at 400 after completing Missing Shipment, and loot items have fixed rarity‑based pricing that no longer varies with colour.
- Item values are calculated from supply stock and a fixed shop list (bandit camp excluded); gold‑floor items, condition‑scaled sales and blueprint prices are defined without bandit influence, the safe pocket only accepts non‑weapon/armour items and values them as the shop would pay, and the shop now buys only finished goods while components are sent to a recycler for a refund.

### Inventory & Loot
- Stash capacity increased by two rows at a time up to a maximum of 96 slots.
- Low‑tier crates and barrels now contain fewer tools and weapons, and junk‑pile crates no longer include ring parts.

### Raid & Extraction
- Extraction balloons no longer carry a secondary hot‑air balloon; escape hatches can be opened with a Cobalt bypass card; outer‑ring crates now have a rare jackpot chance; and raid duration is extended to 35 minutes.
- Raid reset now removes player‑placed structures along with their contents.

### Gameplay & Balance
- Improved beach spawn locations reduce clustering and give more reliable initial placement.
- Fishing vendor updates add new bait options and adjust pricing for better resource management.
- Fixed overlapping train tunnel geometry, preventing players from getting stuck or falling through tunnels.
